Bosnia-Hercegovina 1997/98


FIRST LEVEL

 Championship play-off
 =====================

Championship play-off was played without teams from Republic of Srpska.
Republic of Srpska Football Association made that decision because
they were unsatisfied with conditions defined by UEFA. They asked to
play on neutral ground.
Play-off participants were 4 top muslim and 2 top croat teams, divided
into two groups. Games were played in Sarajevo and Mostar. Final game was
played in Sarajevo at stadium "Kosevo".

  [90' Hadis Zubanovic]
